3649 South Emerald Avenue
Type I Zoning Map Amendment

Narrative and Plans

The Applicant, Sharon Janowski, is proposing a Type | Zoning Map Amendment from a RT-4
Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to a RT-4 Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit
District. The Subject Property is improved with a 2-story, 2-unit residential building.

The Applicant previously owned the vacant lot south of and adjacent to the Subject Property.
The two parcels were deemed one zoning lot and were zoned RS-3 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District. The Subject Property’s zoning was changed to RT-4 Twi-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District but the existing setbacks created non-conformities. The
Applicant proposes to bring the Subject Property into compliance by utilizing this Type 1 Zoning
Map Amendment.

The existing building is approximately 2,282 square foot home, with an 2 car garage. The
overall height of the building is less than the 39’ allowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance.

The Subject Property is unique because the existing building was built prior to the Chicago
Zoning Code. Therefore, the current setback requirements of the Chicago Zoning Code did not

apply at the time the building was constructed.

Proposed Zoning: RT-4 Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
